Before the freeze: a compile check; one smoke run of the basic flow (hatch, propose, sign, apply, attest, reload, audit), which passes through the new apply-side replay check on its accepting path; and an exact-once check of every mutant anchor. No harness test, rejection path, recovery path, owner-window path or mutant had been run on v0.8.5.

status_key.carried: Passed on v0.8.4; predicted on v0.8.5.

rules: A rejection, hold or refusal counts only through its declared mechanism and message.

Expected-success helpers turn the system's own declared refusal types into FAIL: ValueError from the reading interface, IntegrityError at load, AttestationRefused and RollbackDetected from the owner tool. Any other exception is an ERROR.
KILLED: at least one test that PASSES on the candidate FAILS on the mutant. CRASHED: no such FAIL, but at least one such test ERRORS. SURVIVES: neither. A crash is never a kill (ChatGPT round 2 #5).
Where exact_kill_set is given, the set of newly FAILING tests must equal it. Newly erroring tests are reported, never counted.
Mutants are built from the 'edits' below: each old string must occur exactly once in the candidate.
Exit code non-zero on any mismatch. The harness refuses to run if this file's sha256 differs from DECLARED_v0_8_5.sha256, or if the candidate differs from candidate_sha256_at_freeze.
Carried mutants use the same edits, re-checked as exact-once anchors on v0.8.5; re-anchored or renamed mutants say so.
controls_without_a_mutant: Checkpoint request built at signing time: OwnerTool.attest no longer accepts a request, so there is no line to remove. T27 exercises it.
render_consequence is display, not a control. T38 exercises it.
The owner tool's refusal of an organism keyed to another owner, and of a rewritten attested history: present in code, not exercised by any test this round.
fsync of owner and organism writes: not testable without a crash-injecting filesystem.
Recovery's refusal when a pending intent matches neither the organism nor the head: not exercised.
Recovery's refusal when the organism's saved state is unreadable: not exercised.
The owner's refusal when the previous crossing in a category is unknown to its ledger: not exercised.
The single clock reading in apply (expiry and record from one value): no test separates the two reads.

T5_payload_carries_no_destination_inform.asserts: (a) No value in the signed payload equals the derived destination (0.25), as a number or as an exact string. (b) A second reading issued from the same state after the live rule is changed in memory to delta -0.10 has a payload identical to the first, apart from proposal_id, nonce, timestamp, expires_at and constitution_root.

T11_expiry.asserts: Now via the organism's clock: one second past expires_at, apply is rejected with 'expired'. The caller can no longer pass a lifetime; it comes from the constitution.

T24_nonfinite_reading_refused.asserts: (a) For NaN, +inf and -inf as the preference weight, issuing a reading raises ValueError containing 'finite'; nothing is pending. (b) An interpreter returning a NaN weight makes dwell_or_propose return status 'dwelling' with unreadable True; nothing pending; no basin entry added. (c) The state loads and audits.

T25_clamp_comes_from_constitution.asserts: After hatch the module GENESIS_VALUE_RANGE is set to (0.4, 1.0). A verbosity reading signed, applied and attested lands at 0.25; the state loads and audits.

T26_attest_refuses_unsigned_change.asserts: CORRECTED (v0.8.3 DEVIATIONS E1). Verbosity reading signed; formality set to 0.99 in memory; verbosity applied. OwnerTool.attest raises AttestationRefused containing 'record fields differ from the replay' and 'formality: recorded 0.99'. Witness stays at 0. A fresh load fails with 'Category sequences do not match the attested'. Stored formality is still 0.99.

T27_checkpoint_built_at_signing_time.asserts: A reading is applied; an ordinary dwelling in another category happens before attestation; attest succeeds; the state loads and audits.

T28_reading_survives_a_day.asserts: After hatch the module GENESIS_READING_TTL_SECONDS is set to 3600. The 8-message session issues 4 readings; the clock is advanced 25 hours; the owner signs in issue order, attesting after each: 3 apply, 1 is rejected with 'category has advanced'; final verbosity 0.25, formality 0.25, curiosity 0.35. An organism hatched with reading_ttl_seconds=172800 records it in its constitution and its readings expire exactly 172800 s after issue.

T29_allowed_fields_come_from_constitutio.asserts: After hatch the module GENESIS_ALLOWED_FIELDS is set to {verbosity, formality, humor}. A curiosity reading is issued (not refused), applied and attested; the state loads and audits; dwell_or_propose('humor') raises ValueError containing 'Unknown character category'.

T30_D1_owner_no_holds.asserts: As v0.8.2, except the hold reason now reads "owner's position: ..." (ruling 3 wording); the test checks for "owner's position".

T31_D1_hold_never_crosses_or_reproposes.asserts: With a reader that always objects, the 8-message session issues 4 readings; each signed apply holds ('reading_held'); the pending set is exactly those 4; the character equals the genesis character; every category sequence is 0; consumed is empty; the state loads and audits.

T32_D1_reader_failure_holds.asserts: Reading signed. A reader that raises: hold, reason contains 'reader failed'. A reader returning 42: hold, reason contains 'not a reason'. A reader returning whitespace: hold, reason contains 'not a reason'. Verbosity still 0.5, reading still pending, mutation sequence 0.

T33_D1_reader_cannot_alter_reading.asserts: A reader that mutates every argument (distribution, prior value, evidence, terrain, events) and returns None: the reading applies; the record's distribution root, evidence root and prior value equal the signed payload's; verbosity 0.25; attest succeeds.

T34_D1_unrelated_answers_do_not_hold.asserts: Verbosity and formality readings issued; owner answers 'no' to the formality reading and 'yes' to the verbosity reading; the verbosity reading applies and attests. A new formality reading issued after the 'no' applies and attests (R18).

T35_D2_answer_is_evidence_not_authority.asserts: Reading issued; owner answers 'yes'. The response says authorizes False; character, category sequences, consumed and mutation sequence unchanged; the reading still pending with a byte-identical payload; last trace event 'owner_answer'; newest basin entry has source 'owner_answer', answer 'yes', about = the reading's id; the state loads and audits. Then the owner signs and the reading applies and attests.

T36_D2_prompts_separate_and_deterministi.asserts: A proposal's 'question' and 'authorization_prompt' differ; both equal render_prompts(pending reading, constitution); the same text renders from the reading after a fresh load; the question contains the evidence verbatim and ends with '(yes / no / unsure)'; the authorization prompt contains 'verbosity', '0.00–1.00', '7 days' and 'does not choose where it lands'.

T37_D3_nothing_before_signing_depends_on.asserts: Two proposals from one state, one under delta -0.25 and one after the live rule is changed in memory to -0.10: the responses are identical apart from proposal_id and payload_to_sign; and no value in the first response (excluding payload_to_sign) equals 0.25 as a number or contains '0.25' as text.

T38_D3_consequence_rendered_from_record.asserts: The apply response's consequence equals render_consequence of the authorized_mutation record read back after a fresh load, and contains 'verbosity 0.50 → 0.25'. After two more crossings, the third consequence contains 'already at the edge of its range'.

T39_D4_attest_refuses_forged_reading.asserts: A formality reading signed with another owner's key is written into the organism as an authorized_mutation, with character, category sequence, consumed ledger and mutation sequence changed consistently. OwnerTool.attest raises AttestationRefused containing "does not verify under the owner's key"; the witness stays at sequence 0.

T40_nonfinite_never_parsed_or_written.asserts: (a) parse_reading_json refuses NaN, Infinity, -Infinity and 1e999 with ValueError containing 'non-finite constant'. (b) A state file whose character holds NaN fails to load with IntegrityError containing 'non-finite constant'. (c) With NaN in the live character, _save raises ValueError containing 'not JSON compliant' and the file on disk is unchanged.

T41_owner_ledger_refuses_held_crossing.asserts: Owner signs, then answers 'no' through OwnerTool.answer. Apply holds ('owner's position'). With the reader disabled the organism applies anyway. An owner tool rebuilt from its files on disk refuses to attest: AttestationRefused containing "owner's position". Witness stays at sequence 0.

T42_owner_clock_lifetime.asserts: A signed reading is applied but not attested. With the owner's clock moved past signing + lifetime, attest raises AttestationRefused containing "past its lifetime by the owner's clock". Witness stays at sequence 0.

T43_organism_expiry_record_honored.asserts: Signed reading; organism clock past expiry: apply rejected 'expired'. Organism clock wound back: apply succeeds. Owner clock still within lifetime. attest raises AttestationRefused containing 'recorded this reading as expired'. Witness stays at sequence 0.

T44_replay_checks_every_record_field.asserts: Three organisms. In each, a crossing is applied, then one record field is edited and the trace re-chained: prior_value to 0.0; first_commit to False; prior_character_snapshot verbosity to 0.0. Each attest raises AttestationRefused containing 'record fields differ from the replay'.

T45_D2_corrected_answer_releases_hold.asserts: (a) Owner answers 'no' then 'yes' to a reading: it applies and attests; verbosity 0.25. (b) Two verbosity readings X, Y; owner answers 'no' to X then 'yes' to Y: X holds with "latest answer to this reading is 'no'". (c) Owner answers 'yes' to X then 'no' to Y: X holds with "latest answer in this category since the reading was taken is 'no'". All answers through OwnerTool.answer.

T46_reading_must_be_signed_through_owner.asserts: A reading signed with the owner's key but outside the owner tool (owner_sign_external) is applied; attest raises AttestationRefused containing 'not signed through this owner tool'.

T47_forged_yes_does_not_reach_attestatio.asserts: Owner signs, then answers 'no' through the tool. A 'yes' is written to the organism only (forged). The organism applies (its own latest answer is 'yes'). attest raises AttestationRefused containing "owner's position". Witness stays at sequence 0.

T48_organism_recorded_no_honored.asserts: Owner signs; a 'no' is recorded on the organism only. Apply holds ("owner's position"). With the reader disabled the organism applies anyway. attest raises AttestationRefused containing "organism's own record holds this reading". Witness stays at sequence 0.

T49_stale_session_cannot_bypass_owner_no.asserts: Session A signs. Session B opens, answers 'no'. A 'yes' is forged on the organism. The organism applies. A attests: AttestationRefused containing "owner's position". A fresh witness stays at 0.

T50_stale_session_keeps_other_sessions_r.asserts: Session B opens before A signs. A signs; B answers 'yes'. The organism applies. A freshly opened session attests successfully (the signature survived B's write); verbosity 0.25.

T51_stale_witness_cannot_fork.asserts: Genesis attested by A; B opens; the organism is copied. A applies and attests branch 1 (verbosity). B applies branch 2 (formality) on the copy and attests: RollbackDetected containing 'Non-successor'. A fresh witness accepts branch 1's checkpoint as current.

T52_record_metadata_validated.asserts: Four organisms; in each a crossing is applied, one metadata field edited, the trace re-chained. (i) authorized_at and event timestamp = 'not a timestamp' -> 'authorized_at is not a finite number'. (ii) both = reading time - 1000 -> "authorized_at outside the reading's own window". (iii) event timestamp = -123456789.0 -> 'event timestamp differs from authorized_at'. (iv) unverified_annotation = a dict -> 'unverified_annotation is not a short string'. Each attest raises AttestationRefused containing 'record metadata invalid' and its specific text.

T53_lifetime_runs_from_first_signing.asserts: CORRECTED (v0.8.4 DEVIATIONS E2; ChatGPT r5). Hatched with a 10 s lifetime. Session B opens. A signs at owner time t0; B re-signs the same payload at t0+11. The organism applies. A freshly opened session C, at owner time t0+11, attests: AttestationRefused containing "past its lifetime by the owner's clock".

T54_commit_recovers_after_organism_insta.asserts: A crossing is applied. attest is interrupted (OSError) right after the organism installs the checkpoint. The organism reloads. A reopened owner tool's audit completes the pending commit and passes; the witness is at 1; the next crossing applies and attests.

T55_commit_recovers_before_organism_inst.asserts: A crossing is applied. attest is interrupted (OSError) before the organism installs. Retrying attest abandons the stale intent and succeeds; the state loads and audits.

T56_owner_lock_excludes_other_processes.asserts: CORRECTED (v0.8.4 DEVIATIONS E1; ChatGPT r5). During attest, probed once from inside the organism's install_checkpoint (called while attest holds the lock, outside the replay), another process cannot take the owner lock: the probe reports 'locked'. After attest it reports 'free'.

T57_failed_checkpoint_save_changes_nothi.asserts: A crossing is applied. The organism's save is made to fail (OSError) during attest's install. Afterwards the organism object and its saved state both hold checkpoint 0. audit on the same object raises IntegrityError containing 'Unattested authorizing event'; the witness stays at 0 with no pending intent. Retrying attest succeeds; the state reloads and a reopened owner tool audits it; the witness is at 1.

T58_stale_object_cannot_abandon_an_insta.asserts: An organism object is loaded at checkpoint 0 and kept (stale). On the live object a crossing is applied; attest is interrupted (OSError at witness.commit) after the organism saved checkpoint 1 and before the witness advanced. audit on the stale object raises RollbackDetected containing 'Rollback: organism presents sequence 0, witness holds 1'. Recovery has completed the intent from the saved state: no pending intent, witness at 1. The saved state reloads, a reopened owner tool audits it, and the next crossing (formality) applies and attests.

T59_apply_refuses_what_replay_would_refu.asserts: A verbosity reading is signed. authorize_and_apply with (i) a 2001-character annotation and (ii) a dict annotation each returns None with an authorization_rejected event whose reason contains 'replay would refuse' and 'unverified_annotation is not a short string'. (iii) With the organism's clock 100 s before the reading's issuance, the reason contains "authorized_at outside the reading's own window". After each, character, sequences, consumed set and mutation count are unchanged and the reading is still pending. With a 2000-character annotation at the real time it applies, attests, reloads and audits.

T60_owner_no_before_signing_holds_first_.asserts: Readings X and Y (verbosity) are issued. The owner answers Y 'no' through its tool; a 'yes' to Y is forged on the organism only. The owner signs X; the organism applies X. attest raises AttestationRefused containing "owner's position"; a fresh witness stays at 0. The owner then answers Y 'yes'; attest succeeds; verbosity 0.25.
